title: Bangkok to Chiang Mai: Northern Thailand Highlands
subtitle: A 5-day mountain EV road trip through ancient cities and lush highlands

route.kidActivities: Nakhon Sawan Bird Park, Bueng Boraphet
Chiang Mai Night Safari, Doi Suthep
Elephant Nature Park, Chiang Mai Zoo, Grand Canyon water park

bestFor: Families wanting cultural sites and mountain scenery without extreme driving days
tips: Chargers are concentrated in cities along Route 1
The Nakhon Sawan to Lampang gap (~200km) requires careful charge planning
Mountain roads near Chiang Mai are winding but well-paved — drive carefully in rain
seasonal: November to February (cool season, mountain views)
